title.english: The Cargo That Would Not Wait

pairs.target: dìèrtiān shuǐshàng de fēng xiān biàn le . kèdiàn ménbiān de yèzi fān chū qiǎnsè de bèimiàn , zǎo lái xiè cài de rén búzài bǎ kuāng tān zài dìshàng , līn zhe wǎng yánxià kào .
pairs.english: Next day the wind over water changed first. Leaves by the inn door showed pale undersides, and early vegetable unloaders carried baskets under the eaves instead of spreading them on the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天水上的风先变了。客店门边的叶子翻出浅色的背面，早来卸菜的人不再把筐摊在地上，拎着往檐下靠。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi chīfàn shí hái kàndéjiàn duìàn , děng fàngxià wǎn , wūdǐng hòu nàduàn shān yǐ gěi yǔ mǒdiào le yíbàn .
pairs.english: Tavi could still see the opposite bank while eating; by the time he put down his bowl, rain had erased half the mountain behind the roofs.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维吃饭时还看得见对岸，等放下碗，屋顶后那段山已给雨抹掉了一半。

pairs.target: nài lěi yuán xiǎng zài qù kàn yíchù dī shuǐ chūkǒu , lín chūmén jiàng nà yè shōuhuí , shuō jīnrì zhège shuǐwèi , qù le yě bùnéng tì dī shuǐ zuòdá . tā dài tǎ wéi dào dùkǒu kàn dāngrì zěnyàng huànbān , bù zǒu yǐ gěi yǔ zhēzhù de jiù qiǎntān .
pairs.english: Nerai put away her planned low-water-exit page: today's water couldn't answer for low water. She took Tavi to see the ferry's revised schedule, not onto rain-obscured old shallows.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾原想再去看一处低水出口，临出门将那页收回，说今日这个水位，去了也不能替低水作答。她带塔维到渡口看当日怎样换班，不走已给雨遮住的旧浅滩。

pairs.target: ànshàng duī zhe sìzhī cháng kuāng , mǎn shì yèzi guǒ zhe de xiān wù , yígè nánrén shǒu zài pángbiān , gé piànkè biàn qù jiěkāi zuì shàngtóu nà zhī de yìjiǎo , xiàng bú kàn jiù huì huài dé gèng kuài .
pairs.english: Four long baskets of leaf-wrapped perishables stood ashore. A man guarding them kept opening the top corner, as if not looking would spoil them faster.
pairs.hanzi: 岸上堆着四只长筐，满是叶子裹着的鲜物，一个男人守在旁边，隔片刻便去解开最上头那只的一角，像不看就会坏得更快。

pairs.target: lú shí dūn zài lǎn biān kàn shuǐ , lìng yíwèi chuángōng wò zhe gāo zhàn zhe , děng tā bǎ jiǎo biān de fú yè fàngkāi . yèzi tiēzhe ànbiān zǒu , zhuǎn chū bànquān , hūrán jǐshuǐ dài xiàng wàitou .
pairs.english: Lushi crouched by the mooring rope watching water while another boat worker held a pole. She released a floating leaf at her feet; it followed the bank, turned half a circle, then swept outward.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实蹲在缆边看水，另一位船工握着篙站着，等她把脚边的浮叶放开。叶子贴着岸边走，转出半圈，忽然给水带向外头。

pairs.target: tā qǐshēn shuō zhè yítàng bù zhuāng zhè jǐzhī kuāng . nánrén de shǒu hái liúzài kuāng gài shàng , wèn zhǐshì yǔ , háishì lián chuán dōu bùnéng zǒu .
pairs.english: She rose and said these baskets wouldn't go on this trip. His hand still on the lid, the man asked if it was only rain or boats couldn't travel at all.
pairs.hanzi: 她起身说这一趟不装这几只筐。男人的手还留在筐盖上，问只是雨，还是连船都不能走。

pairs.target: tā shuō duìàn hái néng jiē rén , dàn zhèfèn huò yào qù gèng xià tóu de jiù kǒu , nàbiān jīnrì kào bù wěn , bùnéng xiān bǎ huò zhuāngshànglái zài jiào tā xiǎng bànfǎ .
pairs.english: Passengers could still cross, she said, but this freight was for an older landing farther downstream, unsafe to berth today; they couldn't load it first and make her find a way afterwards.
pairs.hanzi: 她说对岸还能接人，但这份货要去更下头的旧口，那边今日靠不稳，不能先把货装上来再叫她想办法。

pairs.target: nánrén shuō nà tā jīnrì de chēqián ne , míngrì yào diū de yòu suàn shuí de . tā méiyǒu dàhǎn , què jiāng kuāng jiǎo zuàn dé hěn jǐn , zhǐjiǎ xià dōu shì hēiní .
pairs.english: What about today's cart fare and tomorrow's losses, the man asked. He didn't shout, but gripped the basket corner hard, black mud beneath his nails.
pairs.hanzi: 男人说那他今日的车钱呢，明日要丢的又算谁的。他没有大喊，却将筐角攥得很紧，指甲下都是黑泥。

pairs.target: lú shí méi jiēzhe tóng tā zhēng qián , jiào lìng yíwèi chuángōng xiān bǎ děng zhe shàngchuán de liǎnggè rén dàidào xīn guà de àn pái qián , shuōmíng huàn qù shàngyóu nǎ yíchù , nǎ bān néng jiē .
pairs.english: Lushi didn't argue about money; she sent the other worker with two waiting passengers to the new shore notice, explaining the upstream transfer and which crossing would connect.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实没接着同他争钱，叫另一位船工先把等着上船的两个人带到新挂的岸牌前，说明换去上游哪一处，哪班能接。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn yígè bào háizi de nǚrén gēnzhe zǒu , wèn nài lěi yào buyào xiān tì tā ná bāo . nài lěi shuō xiān wèn , bié ná le yòu bùzhī sòngwǎng nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Seeing a woman carrying a child follow, Tavi asked Nerai whether to take her bag. Ask first, Nerai said; don't take it without knowing where it goes.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见一个抱孩子的女人跟着走，问奈蕾要不要先替她拿包。奈蕾说先问，别拿了又不知送往哪里。

pairs.target: nǚrén zhī qǐng tā bǎ dìshàng nà zhī xiǎo lán tídào táijiē dǐng , lǐtou shèng zhe jīdàn , qīng dé tā yìzhī shǒu biàn néng wěnzhù . tā tíshàngqù , fàngdào tā zhǐ de gān chù , méiyǒu zài suízhe tā wǎng chuánbiān jǐ .
pairs.english: She asked only for the egg basket on the ground to be carried to the top step. It was light enough for one hand; he set it in the dry spot she indicated and didn't crowd after her toward the boat.
pairs.hanzi: 女人只请他把地上那只小篮提到台阶顶，里头盛着鸡蛋，轻得他一只手便能稳住。他提上去，放到她指的干处，没有再随着她往船边挤。

pairs.target: shǒu kuāng de nánrén hái zài děng . yǔ yǐjīng dǎshī tā de jiān , mù guǎnshì cóng hòutou lái , xiān kàn le kuāng , shuō zìjǐ yánxià néng fàng liǎngzhī , qíyú ruò bù dǎng xièhuò , yě néng xiānjiè diànlǐ yìjiǎo , děng yǔ xiǎo le zài zhǎo tuīchē qù zǒugāo lù .
pairs.english: The man still waited, rain wetting his shoulders. Mou inspected the baskets: two could go under his eaves, the rest in a shop corner if unloading wasn't blocked, then find a handcart for the high road when rain eased.
pairs.hanzi: 守筐的男人还在等。雨已经打湿他的肩，牟管事从后头来，先看了筐，说自己檐下能放两只，其余若不挡卸货，也能先借店里一角，等雨小了再找推车去走高路。

pairs.target: nánrén shuō zǒugāo lù dé duōbàntiān , huò wèibì děng dé . tā dá , shì , suǒyǐ xiān chāikāi kànkàn , huài de bié tóng hào de mēn zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: The man said the high road took half a day longer; the goods might not last. Yes, Mou said, so open them first and separate spoiling goods from good.
pairs.hanzi: 男人说走高路得多半天，货未必等得。他答，是，所以先拆开看看，坏的别同好的闷在一起。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn xiān wù pàrè , shǒuzhǐ xiàyìshí dòng le yíxià , suíjí fàng huíshēn cè .
pairs.english: Hearing the perishables feared heat, Tavi's fingers moved instinctively, then returned to his side.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见鲜物怕热，手指下意识动了一下，随即放回身侧。

pairs.target: bái lǎoshī zhuōshàng de tóng gān , wēnshuǐ yǔ lěng dài quán bú zài zhèlǐ , yǎnqián búshì néng jiào tā shì jiè yìdiǎn de jiājù . tā méiyǒu qù mō kuāng , yě méi bǎ yígè shàng búhuì de bànfǎ dìgěi jiāojí děng zhe de rén .
pairs.english: Instructor Bai's copper rods, warm water, and cold bags weren't here; this wasn't a checked fixture for a tiny trial. He didn't touch the baskets or offer an unlearned remedy to anxious people waiting.
pairs.hanzi: 白老师桌上的铜杆、温水与冷袋全不在这里，眼前不是能叫他试借一点的夹具。他没有去摸筐，也没把一个尚不会的办法递给焦急等着的人。

pairs.target: tā tóng nài lěi bāng zhe nuó dào yánxià de shì liǎngzhī kōng kuāng hé zhēyǔ bù , shèng huò de réng yóu huòzhǔ tóng huǒjì bān , miǎnde bùzhī lǐtou shénme pà yā .
pairs.english: He and Nerai helped move two empty baskets and rain covers under the eaves; the owner and workers handled loaded ones, knowing what couldn't bear pressure.
pairs.hanzi: 他同奈蕾帮着挪到檐下的是两只空筐和遮雨布，盛货的仍由货主同伙计搬，免得不知里头什么怕压。

pairs.target: jiěkāi zuìshàngcéng , guǒrán yǒu jǐpiàn yèzi yǐ mēn chū shēn bān , dǐxià què háihǎo . nánrén fēn dào dìsān bǎ shí , zhōngyú sōngkāi xiānqián yìzhí zuàn zhe de kuāng jiǎo .
pairs.english: Opened, the top leaves showed dark smothered patches, but beneath was still good. On his third handful the man finally released his tight grip on the basket corner.
pairs.hanzi: 解开最上层，果然有几片叶子已闷出深斑，底下却还好。男人分到第三把时，终于松开先前一直攥着的筐角。

pairs.target: lú shí huílái tóng tā zhòngpái chuán cì , méi dāying míngrì yídìng qíng , yě méi bǎ jīnrì méi zǒu de jiù kǒu xiěchéng yǐ sòngdá .
pairs.english: Lushi rearranged crossings with him without promising fine weather tomorrow or recording today's missed old landing as delivered.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实回来同他重排船次，没答应明日一定晴，也没把今日没走的旧口写成已送达。

pairs.target: jǐgè rén shāngliáng le xǔjiǔ , zuìhòu tā xiān màichū qízhōng yíbùfen gěi mù guǎnshì chúfáng , yúxià fēn kuāng tōngqì , děng wèn dào gāo lù de chē . jiàqián bǐ yuánlái shǎo , liǎnshàng bìng bù yīnwèi yǒurén bāngmáng jiù yǒu le xiào .
pairs.english: After long discussion he sold some to Mou's kitchen, split the rest among baskets for air, and waited for high-road transport. The price was lower; help didn't put a smile on his face.
pairs.hanzi: 几个人商量了许久，最后他先卖出其中一部分给牟管事厨房，余下分筐通气，等问到高路的车。价钱比原来少，脸上并不因为有人帮忙就有了笑。

pairs.target: wǔhòu yǔ xiǎo xiàqù , shàngyóu huànlái de nà zhī kèchuán zhào yuē dào le . tǎ wéi rènchū zǎoshàng bào háizi de nǚrén , tā zhàn zài péng xià , cháo ànshàng yígè rén jǔ le jǔ kōng chūlái de shǒu .
pairs.english: As afternoon rain eased, the replacement passenger boat arrived from upstream as agreed. Tavi recognized the woman with the child, raising her freed hand under its canopy toward someone ashore.
pairs.hanzi: 午后雨小下去，上游换来的那只客船照约到了。塔维认出早上抱孩子的女人，她站在篷下，朝岸上一个人举了举空出来的手。

pairs.target: tā zǒu le , nánrén nà jǐ kuāng hái zài yánxià , liǎngjiànshì méiyǒu suízhe tóng yìshēng kāichuán dōu suàn wán .
pairs.english: She left; the man's baskets remained under the eaves. One departure didn't settle both matters.
pairs.hanzi: 她走了，男人那几筐还在檐下，两件事没有随着同一声开船都算完。

pairs.target: wǎnshàng nài lěi bǎ yuán nǐ de lùxiàn tóng shíjì de gǎidòng bìngpái fàngxià , ràng tā zhī xiě zìjǐ gēn guò de nà yíduàn . tǎ wéi xiān xiě le àn pái huàn chù , yòu bǎ dī shuǐ chūkǒu réng wèichá guò liú zhe .
pairs.english: That night Nerai laid the planned route beside actual changes and had him write only what he'd followed. Tavi noted the relocated shore notice and kept the low-water exit unverified.
pairs.hanzi: 晚上奈蕾把原拟的路线同实际的改动并排放下，让他只写自己跟过的那一段。塔维先写了岸牌换处，又把低水出口仍未查过留着。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén qiāo zhe yìzhī dǎokòu de mùpén , děng yǔshēng tíng cái jìxù chàng , chàng de búshì guānmén fēn liáng , shì yìshǒu lián jiǎodǐ ní dōu yào gēnzhe dǒudiào de xiǎodiào .
pairs.english: Outside someone beat an upturned wooden basin, singing when rain stopped: not closed gates and grain shares, but a tune to shake mud off one's feet.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人敲着一只倒扣的木盆，等雨声停才继续唱，唱的不是关门分粮，是一首连脚底泥都要跟着抖掉的小调。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wò zhe bǐ tīng le bànshǎng , huítóu kànjiàn nài lěi zhèng chāi yíkuài liàng shī de bù , zuǐlǐ jìng yě gēnzhe hēng . tā chàng cuò yíjù , yuànlǐ lìkè yǒurén gé chuāng jiūzhèng , shēngyīn bǐ báirì lǐ zhēng chuán cì shí hái xiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi listened with pen in hand and saw Nerai unfolding damp cloth, humming too. She sang a wrong line; someone immediately corrected her through the window, louder than the day's arguments over crossings.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维握着笔听了半晌，回头看见奈蕾正拆一块晾湿的布，嘴里竟也跟着哼。她唱错一句，院里立刻有人隔窗纠正，声音比白日里争船次时还响。
